derivation: from an unused root meaning the same as H7779 (שׁוּף);
def: a kind of serpent (as snapping), probably the cerastes or horned adder

occurrences.text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
